versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.27.2 `--bundle --format=esm --platform=node` build (unminified) of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app): the same app as esbuild-minified, as an ES module — top-level statements, a real `import { basename } from "node:path"`, no wrapper function. KNOWN GAP (plugin-spec I25, the P9 bundle layout): --split fails with no recognizable bundle wrapper. v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
